kata.name: Abstract-factory missing realization - a declared (ModernFactory, table) site with no product, on a cell the frozen sample omits; plus the undeclared-product construction rejection
kata.series_report: docs/ref/pattern-kata-dispositions.md row Abstract Factory (`disposed — construction only; no invariant on a finite instance`); fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-r5k.1
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the kernel names the unfilled declared cell as an executed dangling finding; the frozen sample omits ModernFactory/table, so the baseline misses it (survived, scoped to the declared grid)

expected.detail: the declared realization site (ModernFactory, table) has cell_product = null: T1 declared-grid totality fails at that cell. The frozen sample deliberately omits the pair, so the conventional arm does not inspect it

06-unknown-product.ct.json names the undeclared product GhostChair in cell_product: the document is refused at load with code syntax naming the Cell row; recorded as a construction probe, never counted as a finding

commands: python3 prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: sample omits ModernFactory/table; probe element named
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/01-missing-cell.ct.json --json  # exit 4, 1 dangling
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/06-unknown-product.ct.json --json  # exit 1, data.code syntax

comparison.conventional_baseline: the frozen five-pair sample (omitting ModernFactory/table) and the three sampled kinds all pass; an unfilled declared site outside the sample is never inspected.

baseline.artifact: prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py sha256:4f635702ad371a9c1155965763f18e2fda0d8a6289455fb708fe60e2dcb07c97 (frozen per-fixture (factory, kind) sample; always executed before the probe arm)

expressibility_gap.invariant: every (concrete factory, declared kind) pair has a realization site
expressibility_gap.why: the kernel's totality is over declared Cell rows only. A pair with no Cell row cannot dangle, and there is no quantifier over Factory x Kind; the legal boundary is recorded as G1

expressibility_gap.invariant: every declared product is realized by some factory
expressibility_gap.why: ModernTable exists in Product but no cell references it; without a product_witness : Product -> Cell arrow the kernel has no coverage surface over Product (G4)

discrepancies: Construction-run baseline: the first baseline implementation asserted its sample against the raw JSON of 06-unknown-product.ct.json and identified cell:ModernFactory/chair (sample:ModernFactory/chair:product-undeclared). The stated protocol is that the conventional arm loads the document before calling a factory, so an unloadable document is recorded as arm-not-run; the script was corrected to that rule. The unique set is empty under either reading, so no detection claim moves. Recorded here rather than hidden.
Orphan product: ModernTable and, in 02-wrong-kind, ModernSofa are unreferenced by any cell; the kernel is silent on both, consistent with gap G4.
procedure: 1. The law (AF-T, declared-grid product-family totality) and the fault matrix were committed in fixtures/katas/abstract-factory/ before any recorded run (README.md, faults.json); the pre-registration sections are not edited after the run.

2. The baseline arm (prototype/abstract_factory_baseline.py, sha256 pinned in comparison.baseline.artifact) was executed first: a frozen per-fixture sample of (factory, kind) realization sites asserting exactly one declared Cell, a resolved product, kind agreement, family agreement, plus one coverage assertion per sampled kind. Sites outside the sample are never inspected.

3. The probe arm ran the same fixtures through the real CLI: `catherine check --json`. Witnesses were mapped to presentation elements cell:<Factory>/<Kind> (dangling on cell_product/cell_factory/cell_kind, equation violations on a Cell row, key collisions on the shared site) and kind:<Kind> (dangling on kind_witness).

4. unique_detections = executed probe elements minus baseline-identified elements. The constructed catalog is not consulted (the kata id is unregistered there, so expectations are the pre-registered rows in this record). A construction rejection is recorded but never counted.

5. Verdict follows the recorded rule: empty unique = killed; non-empty unique with an executed baseline arm = survived; a claim resting only on a hypothesis or construction probe would be inconclusive.
